why: The student says an all-zero row is acceptable, which is the documented RowsNeedNotSumToOne misconception. In fact every row must sum to 1. Here the row is all zeros only because of integer division (counts[j]/outDegree with outDegree 5 gives 0), not because the page has no links.

concepts.why: This uses the wrong rule that a row may be all zeros, but a probability row must sum to 1.

concepts.quote: it just means the page has no links
concepts.why: A page with no links needs 1/N in every column, not zeros. Also, this page has outDegree 5, so it is not dangling.
